description.value: Each gains temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level and a +1 status bonus to attack rolls for the duration. Once per Afflicted per casting, an Afflicted destroyed by damage takes one final action before it collapses.

cinderfall.incomplete: Temp HP grant (2x level) correctly stays unbuilt per the P-TEMPHP convention (real pf2e never encodes triggered temp-HP grants via system.rules regardless of scaling formula; cite pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/archetype/necrologist/level-8/dismal-harvest.json). The +1 status bonus to attack for each Afflicted is buildable via a same-actor companion effect (P-BUFF-VIA-EFFECT, same pattern as Steady Chorus: [{"key": "FlatModifier", "selector": "attack", "type": "status", "value": 1}]) but no such companion (plaguesworn.pallbearers-effect.json) exists yet -- not created in this pass. The "a destroyed Afflicted gets one final action" clause is INCOMPLETE outright: it hands the Afflicted a wholly new triggered action, and no selector exists for a minion's post-death action.
